condition: heart failure with ejection fraction 45% or higher, NYHA class II to IV, elevated natriuretic peptides, structural heart disease
intervention: sacubitril-valsartan, target dose 97 mg sacubitril with 103 mg valsartan twice daily
comparator: valsartan, target dose 160 mg twice daily

statistical_analysis_plan.alpha_note: final two-sided threshold, adjusted for the interim analysis
statistical_analysis_plan.gatekeeping: Secondary hypotheses are tested confirmatorily only if the primary hypothesis is rejected. The renal composite is among the gated secondary hypotheses.

outcomes.measure: total hospitalisations for heart failure and death from cardiovascular causes

source.document: NEJM 2019, Solomon et al., Angiotensin-Neprilysin Inhibition in Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction

outcomes.measure: renal composite: 50% or greater decrease in estimated glomerular filtration rate, development of end-stage renal disease, or death from renal causes
